what: the corpus lane's spelling bridge: the 1,173 places where our text spells a word otherwise than the Leningrad text STEP and MACULA follow, each with its class and, at 1,035 of them, STEP's pieces cut onto our letters. Kept here byte for byte in the folder the lane keeps it in, with its rule and its receipt, and beside it the lane's list of the nine form rows not landed. tools/apply-spelling-bridge-v1.mjs lays the place's pieces on the zone at the classes named under `laid`, and the reader draws the place's line from them as it does at every place that carries pieces. What a zone carries for a place is said once, in tools/spelling-bridge-v1.mjs

form_rows.kept_by: data/landings/PIN.json, which lands these rows (ship 11c); read here only as the same bytes

laid.why: STEP's spelling column writes our letters at the place and cuts them, and one form row of the same relay is STEP's own row for the place. The place's pieces are our letters as the list cuts them, and each piece's English is that row's own words cut at the stroke, as STEP writes them, brackets and all. The list's English for the same piece is held equal to it, the brackets aside

not_laid.why: the list gives each piece's English with STEP's square and angle brackets taken off, and no row of STEP's in this tree is named for these places, so the words as STEP writes them are not on hand. At 731 of them STEP's own reading stands already (call 4 of relay v189). Put to the corpus lane: the pieces' English as STEP writes it

tags: not written in this pass. The list gives each piece its tag, and the place's entry would be its core piece's. A zone's tag is the lattice's (check-entry-gate-v1 holds each tagged word to the lattice's core tags), so the place keeps what it carries: the entries of MACULA's lemma at 192 of the 206, none at 14. At 205 of the 206 the core piece's number is among the entries the place is asked already, or the place is asked none
lifted_by: the lane's next lattice, where it reads these places under our spelling and gives them pieces itself. The tool refuses a place that carries other pieces than these, and this pin is retired then
note: every sha256 here is the one the relay's letter names for the file, and the lane's receipt names the three lists by the same. The lane's folder also holds its builder, its second count and that count's receipt; those files are not kept here.
